relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: Seven days after SNI, the number of CSF1+ cells significantly increased compared with Sham condition in all DRG

relationships.subject: CSF1
relationships.evidence_quote: SNI-induced CSF1 expression was common for all subtypes of mouse DRG neurons, being responsible for attracting more resident macrophages around them in a DRG-dependent manner

relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: there was a significant increase in the total number of CX3CR1+ microglia in the whole ipsilateral half of the SC 7 days after the lesion

key_findings: SNI increased CSF1+ neurons in L3-L5 DRG (strongest in L4), all surrounded by CX3CR1+ macrophage rings
CSF1+/NF200+ neurons were most frequent (~52%) but microglia increased more in laminae I-II, consistent with a stronger influence of CSF1+/IB4+ and CSF1+/CGRP+ nociceptors
